_comment: Calibration corpus pool. See lib/fantasy/calibration.js. Regenerate ONLY as a deliberate recalibration with a methodology-doc update. ROW ORDER IS PART OF THE FIXTURE: engine.createDraftState sorts the pool by ADP with a STABLE sort, so players sharing an ADP are drafted in the order they appear here, and a different order produces different drafts (measured: up to 3pp of A-rate on the same pool). Rows are therefore emitted ORDER BY scoring_format, teams_count, adp, ffc_player_id so a regeneration is reproducible. Note the live monitor (/api/cron/adp-snapshot) queries without ORDER BY, so its reading can differ from this fixture by that much - bands are chosen with enough ceiling headroom to cover it.
